name: Rajputana Biodiesel Ltd
about: Founded in 2016, Rajputana Biodiesel Limited produces and supplies biofuels and their by-products - glycerine and fatty acids.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Rajputana Biodiesel is engaged in manufacturing and supplying biofuels and their by-products, including biodiesel, glycerine, and fatty acids.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 32.1%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 100 days to 186 days
